purpose: Prevent observation-window cache eviction from conflating attention instrumentation, question visibility, pooling, physical budgets, variable-length state, and downstream diagnostic validity.

sources.transferred: trailing observation queries vote over prefix positions, pooling clusters nearby tokens, selected prefix is concatenated with the full observation window
sources.not_transferred: window 16/32/64, kernels 5/7/13, max versus average pooling, fixed token budgets, task quality, and A100 speed/memory ratios

sources.transferred: within-layer adaptive physical-head budgets and separate question-aware/question-agnostic evaluation
sources.not_transferred: upstream runtime, safeguard, GQA max reduction, model adapters, data, and empirical quality

findings: native global attention calls fused scaled_dot_product_attention and returns only projected outputs
the Transformers wrapper explicitly rejects output_attentions and output_hidden_states
AttentionState stores one equal-capacity rectangular tensor per layer and KV head
AttentionState append implements chronological ring eviction, not arbitrary token identities or unequal head lengths
no qualified flattened or variable-length per-head attention kernel exists

current_blockers: there is no attention-weight probe with parity against the production attention output
there is no immutable token-identity map through selection, observation retention, decode append, serialization, and resume
question-visible and reusable question-agnostic prefix modes are not implemented as distinct cache lifecycles
pooling type, width, boundary padding, and score-to-selected-token identity are unselected
the current rectangular ring cannot realize unequal physical-head budgets without padding away state savings
no target-hardware variable-length correctness, memory, or latency evidence exists
no held-out test shows all-required-source recall predicts composition failure beyond retained mass and attention-output error

stage_0_attention_probe.scope: read-only offline probe on a frozen checkpoint; do not change Attention.forward or training
required_inputs: exact token ids, prompt boundaries, absolute positions, layer/cache occurrence, dtype, and device
named query/KV head counts, head dimension, RoPE/NoPE path, scale, mask, and output projection
stage_0_attention_probe.reference: materialize FP32 query-key logits and causal probabilities for only the requested observation rows; expand physical GQA keys by the declared equal grouping; compute value/output results before and after the native output projection
parity: manual dense output versus production SDPA output at batch one and two
prefill blocks and one-token decode with and without prior state
GQA3 and MQA1 geometries only after their parent representation is authorized
NoPE and any active positional path separately
absolute/relative output error, top-token identities, row-sum error, and non-finite counts
stage_0_attention_probe.memory_rule: chunk observation queries and never materialize an L-by-L matrix; the probe is diagnostic and cannot be counted as serving performance
stage_0_attention_probe.success: all frozen parity thresholds in a successor protocol pass on CPU reference and target GPU before any salience comparison

salience_definition.prompt_partition: prefix positions [0,L-W) are eviction candidates; trailing positions [L-W,L) are the always-retained observation window
salience_definition.probability: compute each observation query's causal softmax over every prompt key visible in the production dense forward, then slice the prefix columns without renormalization
salience_definition.observation_aggregation: arithmetic mean over exactly W observation-query rows; sum is an identity control because fixed W changes only one common positive scale
salience_definition.gqa_reduction: arithmetic mean over equal-size query-head groups using the qualified GQA reference; sum is an identity control; max is negative-control-only
salience_definition.pooling_order: aggregate observation rows, reduce GQA groups, then apply stride-one positional pooling over prefix scores
salience_definition.pooling_boundaries: zero padding of floor(kernel/2) for odd kernels; retain original prefix identity at every pooled output index
salience_definition.selection: derive physical-head budgets, then select descending pooled score with ascending token identity ties
salience_definition.selected_payload: gather original unpooled K and V at selected prefix identities; pooling changes scores, never payload values
salience_definition.deduplication: prefix excludes observation positions by construction; selected prefix identities are unique within each physical head
salience_definition.budget: B_prefix counts selected physical prefix slots across KV heads; total persistent prompt state is B_prefix plus K*W always-retained physical observation slots

visibility_modes.lifecycle: serialize the complete task prompt, including its question/instruction, run dense prefill, then score with its trailing W prompt states
visibility_modes.claim_limit: query-conditioned prompt eviction only; moving the question earlier does not make this question-agnostic because later causal states can encode it

visibility_modes.lifecycle: prefill and compress context before any future question/instruction tokens exist, serialize once, and reuse the identical compressed prefix for multiple held-out questions
visibility_modes.claim_limit: the only mode that supports reusable question-agnostic prefix-cache evidence

visibility_modes.lifecycle: score prefix positions from frozen future generated-query attention after a full dense run without feeding selections back into that run
visibility_modes.claim_limit: descriptive upper bound only; impossible online information and no deployable-method claim

conditional_experiment_order.advance: only exact frozen prompt/state fixtures passing numerical and identity parity

conditional_experiment_order.fixed: no pooling, uniform physical budgets, same checkpoint/prompt/question/output
conditional_experiment_order.advance: retain both deployable modes for their distinct claims; hindsight remains an oracle

conditional_experiment_order.initial_geometry: W=32 and odd kernel=7 as a literature baseline, not a selected Speck value
conditional_experiment_order.advance: select separately by visibility mode using source-complete recall and end-task floors
smallest non-dominated state-plus-probe-cost geometry passing held-out quality

arms: adaptive budgets with conservation-safe uniform_fraction=1/5 control
conditional_experiment_order.advance: adaptive promotion requires paired benefit beyond the uniform baseline; safeguard requires its own paired benefit and is never pooled with unsafeguarded adaptive

cache_lifecycle.prefill: compute dense prompt outputs first; eviction cannot change prefill logits
cache_lifecycle.compressed_prompt: store selected prefix plus complete observation window with absolute positions and per-head lengths
cache_lifecycle.decode: append every generated KV without re-evicting for the frozen maximum output length; prompt state and generated suffix remain distinct
cache_lifecycle.overflow: generation beyond the frozen output length is unsupported until a separate recurrent eviction policy is qualified
cache_lifecycle.prefix_reuse: context-only mode must reproduce fresh materialization for every held-out question from identical serialized bytes
cache_lifecycle.serialization: persist token identities, absolute positions, lengths, dtype/scales, selection configuration, and source checkpoint hash
cache_lifecycle.resume: resumed logits and cache identities must match uninterrupted execution at every tested split

attention: retained raw attention mass before pooling
retained pooled score reported separately from probability mass
L1 and relative-RMS attention-output error before and after output projection
per-layer/head concentration, budgets, selected ages, and observation-to-prefix mass
source_completeness: route, payload, and direct composition strata
single-source controls matched on distance, span length, and distractor load
diagnostics.predictive_test: on held-out examples, compare preregistered nested predictors of task failure using retained mass and output error versus those baselines plus all-required-source recall; use grouped cross-validation by template/document and report calibration, discrimination, and paired bootstrap uncertainty
diagnostics.causal_test: restore exactly one missing required source at a time without changing total physical budget, evict a matched non-required span, and test whether predicted source-completeness and task output recover together

quality_and_multiplicity.language: frozen validation-loss non-inferiority and every-source guardrails from the selected parent experiment
quality_and_multiplicity.long_context: uncontaminated RULER v2, qualified HELMET families, and source-complete synthetic composition; unavailable suites remain failed release gates
quality_and_multiplicity.unit: paired example, seed/data cell, length, visibility mode, pooling arm, window/kernel, and budget are all retained
quality_and_multiplicity.correction: freeze primary contrasts and Holm families in a successor after parent representation/checkpoint and available datasets are known
quality_and_multiplicity.no_proxy_substitution: attention mass, output error, and source recall are diagnostics and cannot replace end-task quality

systems_gate.state: count physical K/V bytes, variable-length metadata, positions, quantization scales, observation window, and generated suffix; padded rectangular allocation is reported both logically and physically
systems_gate.probe_cost: report offline salience probe time/memory separately and exclude it from steady decode only when prefix caching amortization is explicitly measured
systems_gate.runtime: correct variable-length or masked reference first, then a target-hardware kernel; padding that preserves dense physical allocation cannot claim memory savings
systems_gate.threshold: a retained arm must pass its parent quality constraints and improve a preregistered end-to-end serving metric by at least 10% on the named target hardware

decision.next_action: freeze a checkpoint-specific offline attention-probe parity protocol only after the three-pair Paper 1 baseline result selects or rejects the candidate parent
